quarantine_policy.policy: Generic 3D/image/audio generation skills are disabled optional fallbacks only. Provider credential presence MUST NEVER enable or prefer them (REQ-BIND-007); enablement requires an explicit optional fallback capability declared by studio project policy, never credential auto-detection.

specialist_bindings.summary: Screens and adapts threejs-game-skills gameplay-systems knowledge (player movement feel, camera behavior, interaction logic, enemy behavior patterns) for Gauntlet capability work. Disclosed only under the studio physics and navigation contracts it is bound to; never owns authoritative gameplay state, navmesh generation, terrain heightfields, or physics stepping.

Screens and adapts threejs-game-skills AAA-graphics knowledge (post-processing stacks, material and shader polish, render pipeline tuning, color grading) for Gauntlet visual quality work. Disclosed under the studio composition and optimization contracts; never performs reference-image reconstruction, terrain elevation math, or asset licensing intake.
do_not_use_when: reconstructing a depicted object from reference image

specialist_bindings.summary: Screens and adapts threejs-game-skills game-UI knowledge (HUD layout, menu and interface flow, diegetic interfaces, DOM/CSS game presentation) for Gauntlet interface work. Disclosed through studio handoffs only; visible HUD acceptance settles through deterministic browser verification, never through the specialist itself.

Screens and adapts threejs-game-skills debug/profiler knowledge (frame-time profiling, draw-call and memory diagnostics, runtime performance telemetry, bandwidth/latency inspection, bottleneck diagnosis) for Gauntlet performance work. Exploratory diagnosis only; never mutates authoritative state, steps physics, or substitutes for settlement-grade browser proof.

Screens and adapts threejs-game-skills QA/release knowledge (release readiness checklists, smoke test planning, regression triage, quality gate review) for Gauntlet release work. Planning and triage only; deterministic proof execution, pixel capture, and scenario settlement remain owned by the studio browser-proof capability.
